## Save video

This is your output preview 🎉🥳

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs

Everything here is optional except the reference sheet.

### Prompt

Enter a positive prompt. To rewrite it into a fuller description first, enable
**enhance positive prompt** on the Input Parameters node below. The negative
prompt is used as written and is never enhanced.

Supplying an **LTX API key** encodes and enhances the prompt through the API
instead of locally, which saves memory. The workflow switches over on its own
whenever a key is present - there is nothing to un-bypass.

See the [prompting guide](https://docs.ltx.io/open-source-model/usage-guides/prompting-guide).

### Reference sheet

Load one image holding the elements you want the model to draw on - characters,
props, wardrobe, a location - laid out side by side. Describe them in the prompt
and refer to them by their position on the sheet, so the model knows which
element you mean.

The sheet is resized once and then held on every frame as the IC-LoRA guide, so
it steers the whole clip rather than only the opening moment. It does **not**
become the first frame: **bypass** on the Preprocess node is on by default.
Turn it off if you do want the sheet itself to open the video.

### Frame rate and duration

Set both below. The frame count has to be 1 + a multiple of 8, so the duration
actually used is worked out from the fps and the duration you ask for, and may
come out slightly shorter than requested.

nodes.title: Generate
widgets_values:
## Generate

**Sampler - Distilled (8 steps)**

Runs the distilled ltx-2.5 model with the ingredients IC-LoRA applied, in 8
steps. You can change the noise seed, the guider cfg (used for both video and
audio) and the sampler. The guide frames are cropped out afterwards
(`LTXVCropGuides`) so only the generated video is decoded.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

Holds the reference sheet on every frame (`RepeatImageBatch`) to build the guide
video, and injects it through the IC-LoRA (`LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide`) so the
elements on the sheet steer the whole clip.

It also builds the empty audio-video latent at the sheet's resized size and the
requested frame count.

`bypass` is on by default, so the sheet acts purely as a reference and does not
become the opening frame. Turn it off to condition on it as the first frame as
well; `img_compression` then controls how much the conditioning copy is degraded.

The guide frames are cropped out during sampling (`LTXVCropGuides`) so only the
generated video is decoded.

nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16x16, ov 2 - 16f ov 4 |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24x24, ov 6 - 16f ov 4 |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32x32, ov 8 - 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48x48, ov 12 - 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24x24, ov 6 - no temporal split |

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ IC-LoRA Ingredients - ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-ingredients-0.9.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Ingredients)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)

- Video VAE - one of these:
  - [ Diffusion decoder ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) - Best quality
  - [ Convolutional decoder - ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors) - Lower memory & faster


**Text Encoder - finetuned for LTX-2.5**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors)


**Model Storage Location**

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │      ├── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │      └── ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-ingredients-0.9.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors / ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
```

## Report Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)
